caption: The drawing features a single glass bell with a twisted handle, depicted in a centered, vertical orientation. The bell is rendered in pale tones of white, light tan, and gray, giving it a translucent and reflective appearance. The handle at the top is spiraled and light pinkish-gray in color. The main body of the bell is clear with a slightly silvery sheen and detailed white decoration, including the text “WORLD’S FAIR 1893” encircled within an ornate border on the front. The clapper inside the bell, attached by a thin chain, is golden yellow and visible through the glass. In the upper right quadrant of the image, there is a circular design containing the inscription “COLUMBIAN EXPOSITION. 1893. WORLD'S FAIR” arranged in a circular fashion inside a lightly sketched circle within a square border. The entire drawing is set against a plain, uncolored background with faint pencil border lines, and the words “Actual Size” appear in fine print in the bottom left corner while the name “S. Klein” is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Glass Bell
